log_proof: For x>1, ln x=2*sum_{j>=0} z^(2j+1)/(2j+1), z=(x-1)/(x+1). Positive omitted terms give ln2>2/3 and ln3>1. Therefore ln16>8/3 and ln24=3ln2+ln3>3.
